subject.title: Feishu plugin: remove dependency on contact:contact.base:readonly for sender name resolution

question: Should bundled Feishu make contact-free sender identity the default, reserving contact-backed friendly-name and live user-directory lookup for explicit opt-in?
rationale: This changes the default permission boundary and existing friendly-name behavior for a bundled production channel; source inspection establishes the tradeoff but cannot decide the intended product and security policy.

options.title: Contact-Free Default
options.body: Prefer exact event or chat-member metadata, fall back quietly to stable sender IDs, and require explicit opt-in for contact-backed profile and live-directory lookup.

options.title: Keep Contact Lookup Default
options.body: Preserve current friendly-name behavior while narrowing permission errors, validating guidance URLs, and documenting the broad scope requirement more clearly.

recommendation.title: Contact-Free Default
recommendation.body: Prefer exact event or chat-member metadata, fall back quietly to stable sender IDs, and require explicit opt-in for contact-backed profile and live-directory lookup.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the issue assignee and owns the open maintainer PR nearest to the affected sender-name path.
